name: Holly M. Butler
background: Holly M. Butler is a Lander, Fremont County resident who ran as a Libertarian for House District 54 and lost the Nov. 3, 2026 general election (20.1% of the vote), as already recorded from official results.

Her campaign site, holly4hd54.com, emphasizes individual liberty, limited government, and transparent communication. It lists a Lander contact and does not state an occupation, education, or prior office.
No public occupation, education, or military record was found in the sources reviewed for this fill.

positions.text: Campaign site emphasizes individual liberty, personal freedom, limited government, transparent communication, and reducing unnecessary bureaucracy and regulations.
